diagnosis: Customer is hitting 429 errors due to sustained high throughput (5,400 rpm) during a specific nightly window. As this exceeds standard plan ceilings, a capacity review is required per policy.
reply:
Thank you for contacting support regarding the 429 responses during your nightly batch. I have reviewed your account details and the traffic patterns you described. Rate limits are set per plan, and increases above the plan ceiling require a capacity review. To proceed, please confirm the peak sustained requests per minute and the specific window over which it was measured so we can evaluate your request. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.

For more information on how we handle these requests, please refer to our article on Requesting a rate limit increase (kb-0004) and Reading 429 responses and backing off correctly (kb-0014).
